messages:
Maria: Heads-up — planning a coordinated cross-region swap for the quantized runtime kernel (quant-kernel v2.2) to replace v2.1 in us-east-1 and eu-west-1. Target window tonight 22:00 UTC. Need signoffs and a short playbook for rollback/pinning. :rocket:

Tomas: +1 on timeline. Can you confirm whether the canary will use the same instance types (p4d -> p4d) or if we're testing aarch64 nodes in eu-west-1?

Maria: Canary uses same instance types for this run (p4d). We will run a separate edge aarch64 verification next week. Goal is to validate kernel-change-only behavior first.

Kevin: Two quick asks: (1) add a KV-cache warmup period to canary traffic to avoid cold-cache noise, (2) make sure rollback pins are ready.

Maria: Agree. Proposed steps:```
1) Start 5% canary in us-east-1 and eu-west-1 concurrently.
2) Wait 15m for KV warmup and observe backend p95 and error spike.
3) If stable, shift to 25% over 30m, then full rollout after 2h stable.

Deploy commands:
/deploybot start-canary --service=runtime-engine --image=redwood/runtime:quant-v2.2 --regions=us-east-1,eu-west-1 --canary=5% --kv-warmup=900s
```

Jess: Add metric gates: abort if p95 latency increases >15% relative baseline OR overall 5xx rate >0.5% for 10m. Also fail if tail latency >200ms for model-gen path.

Maria: Gate thresholds noted. We'll wire them into deploybot preflight.

deploybot: [bot] Preflight checks passed. Image redwood/runtime:quant-v2.2 exists in registry. Healthcheck script OK.

Oscar: I'm on watch for memory regressions — quant kernels sometimes change allocation patterns. I'll run a quick heap/alloc trace during the canary.

Tomas: One more compatibility checkpoint: quant-v2.2 introduces a new kernel ABI flag (kv-prefetch=on). We should ensure fallback codepath to ABI v1 is available if a region receives older model shards. If deploybot needs to swap, we must be able to pin to redwood/runtime:quant-v2.1 instantly.

Maria: Agreed. Pin command (prepared):
```
/deploybot pin --service=runtime-engine --tag=quant-v2.1 --reason="rollback-fallback"
```

Kevin: Also prewarm canary with a small synthetic prompt set that matches typical customer seq-len distribution. I'll push the set to the canary group.

Jess: Who's owning the observation dashboard? I can add a temporary per-canary dashboard with token-level breakdowns and error traces. :eyes:

Oscar: I'll capture memory and CUDA metrics and post summaries.

sre-oncall: I'll monitor infra alarms and can trigger region-level failover if needed. Please ensure we have runbook steps pinned in PagerDuty incident if we need to cross-region rollback.

Maria: OK owners: Kevin -> synthetic prompts, Jess -> dashboard + alert thresholds, Oscar -> mem/CUDA trace, SRE -> infra gating and PD runbook. I'll kick off the deploy.

deploybot: [bot] Starting canary: runtime-engine @ redwood/runtime:quant-v2.2
canary id: cb-20260314-91f3
regions: us-east-1 (5%), eu-west-1 (5%)
started_at: 1842109906

Kevin: Synthetic traffic started. KV warmup in progress.

Oscar: Memory trace: first 10m looks comparable. No OOMs. Posting short logs:```
[us-east-1] avg_rss=5.2GB, p95_rss=6.1GB
[eu-west-1] avg_rss=5.1GB, p95_rss=6.0GB
```

Jess: Dashboard temp link: https://console.internal/redwood/dashboards/cb-20260314-91f3 (shared)

sre-oncall: Infra alarms green. Latency looks slightly up in eu-west-1 (+8% p95) but below gate. No 5xx spike.

Tomas: Noting a small tokenization perf diff in eu-west-1 for some legacy models (short sequences). Kevin, can your synthetic set exercise that pattern?

Kevin: Added a short-seq subset, re-run.

deploybot: [bot] Canarying to 25% after 35m.

Oscar: CUDA mem pattern steady. No device-side errors.

Jess: Monitoring for the 10m gate window: p95 baseline was 110ms. Current p95 us-east-1=118ms, eu-west-1=125ms. eu-west is +13.6% (within our 15% gate). No 5xx.

Maria: Looks acceptable. We'll keep gradual rollout. Reminder: if eu-west crosses 15% or 5xx>0.5% for 10m, we immediately pin and rollback with the deploybot pin command above.

Tomas: Suggest adding a short circuit for affected maps: if specific model-id shows regression, route only that model to v2.1 until patched. Is that feasible?

Kevin: Yes — routing table supports per-model override. I'll prepare a quick mapping.

deploybot: [bot] Rolling to 100% in us-east-1 over 90m; eu-west-1 at 50% ongoing.

Jess: eu-west-1 p95 creep continues to 132ms (~20% up from baseline) — crossing gate. Error still low.

Maria: Triggering rollback for eu-west-1 only. Issuing pin + rollback.

Maria: ```
/deploybot pin --service=runtime-engine --tag=quant-v2.1 --reason="eu-west p95 >15%"
/deploybot rollback --service=runtime-engine --canary-id=cb-20260314-91f3 --regions=eu-west-1
```

deploybot: [bot] Pin applied: runtime-engine pinned to quant-v2.1 for region eu-west-1. Rollback started.

Oscar: After rollback, memory and p95 stabilized back to baseline within 8m. Posting post-rollback metrics.

Jess: Confirming dashboards show eu-west back to p95=112ms. us-east remained on v2.2 and is stable.

sre-oncall: Closing incident watch for eu-west since rollback successful. We'll keep a 24h monitor window.

Tomas: Good call to do cross-region canary. Action items: log the specific model ids that tripped eu-west, create a short PR to revert the kv-prefetch ABI toggle for that model class, and schedule a follow-up canary next week for aarch64 nodes.

Maria: Thanks everyone. I'll draft release notes: mention v2.2, kernel ABI kv-prefetch on by default, partial rollout, eu-west rollback, mitigation steps, and next canary. Will tag owners and close the release once follow-ups are tracked. :thumbsup:
